Why we exist

A simpler choice

Apps should be useful or fun. They should not try to hold your attention, collect information they do not need, or push you to spend money.

Many apps make money from advertising, subscriptions, and in-app purchases. The longer and more often people use them, the more money they can make. This can lead to constant notifications, daily streaks, expiring rewards, endless feeds, artificial limits, and paid shortcuts.

Some of these features can be useful or enjoyable. The problem is when they are added mainly to keep people in the app or make them pay. Then the app is no longer built mainly for the person using it.

∞

Our mission

Truly free means complete.

We make simple, useful apps and games that people can enjoy on their own terms. They should do their job well without asking for extra time, money, or personal information.

New tools, including artificial intelligence, make small apps easier and less expensive to build. We want to use that progress to create complete, dependable apps that are truly free.

We do not try to keep people engaged for as long as possible. We make apps worth using and leave people free to decide when to use them and when to stop.

The FinitePlay Promise

Nothing hidden in “free.”

Every official FinitePlay app follows the same simple rules.

01

Free to use

No trial, subscription, paid tier, or storefront hiding inside the app.

02

No advertising

Your attention will not be sold while you use our software.

03

No in-app purchases

No essential features, virtual items, shortcuts, or advantages for sale.

04

Private by design

No behavioral profiles or sale of information about how you use an app.

05

No account required

You should not have to identify yourself merely to use a simple app.

06

Offline when possible

Software should not depend on a remote service when it does not need one.

07

No pressure to return

No punitive streaks, artificial waits, expiring rewards, or nagging alerts.

08

Clear and honest

We explain every permission and what information, if any, an app processes.

Healthy use

Enjoyment without exploitation.

Game addiction is a real problem. People engage with games in different ways: a game that is easy for one person to put down may be difficult for another.

We cannot promise that any game is addiction-proof or guarantee healthy use for everyone. What we can promise is that we will not deliberately exploit the risk of compulsive use.

We will not manufacture urgency, punish people for taking a break, or pressure them to return. We want people to enjoy our apps, stop when they choose, and come back only when they want to.

First projects

Familiar games, built differently.

We are starting with timeless card games designed for quiet, private, offline play.

Why an LLC

Small by design.

FinitePlay is a mission-driven limited liability company, not a nonprofit corporation or tax-exempt charity. A formal nonprofit requires governance, administration, and ongoing reporting that would take time and money away from the software.

We are enthusiasts who love building high-quality software in our free time and want to give something useful back to the community. A simple LLC gives the work a stable legal home while letting us stay focused.

Sustainability

Support without strings.

FinitePlay may accept voluntary support, grants, or other funding compatible with this mission. Support will never unlock features, remove inconvenience, provide an advantage, or change how anyone is treated.

FinitePlay is not tax-exempt. Payments support a for-profit-form company and are not tax-deductible charitable donations.

Build something better with us

Good software can be a gift.

Developers, testers, designers, translators, accessibility advocates, and supporters can all help. Tell us what you care about and how you would like to contribute.
